title: Include equipment count in SRD importer CLI summary
description:
## Problem

runImporter returns result.counts.equipment, but the CLI summary omits it. This is a small polish/regression issue, but it makes importer output less useful when checking generated pack coverage.

## Relevant files

- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/index.ts
- packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/cli.ts
- CLI output tests, if present

## Requirements

- Add equipment to the CLI Imported
close_reason: Already fixed in PR #116 (commit 838c099): equipment was added to the CLI summary string and is tested in pipeline.test.ts (result.counts.equipment). No code change needed.
